events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: Your dispute is closed with no change: the $6.61 cancellation fee stands and no refund is due.

What decided it: your driver was already at the pickup point when he marked himself as arrived, stayed there more than three minutes, and only then cancelled. Records show the driver waited, so this counts as a rider no-show rather than a driver cancellation.

The $6.61 was charged as a cancellation fee. No credit is being added to your account, and no flag or restriction is placed on it.

If you think the records are wrong, reply to this message and a person will review the case.

DRIVER: Good news — your cancellation fee is upheld. You'll receive $4.50 as your share of the $6.61 fee, paid as a Ryde voucher on your account.

What decided it: you marked yourself as arrived while you were within the pickup zone, and you stayed within that zone for more than three minutes before cancelling. That meets the no-show standard, so the fee applies.

No action is being taken against your account.

If you have questions about the voucher or this decision, reply and a person will take a look.
